title: author_is_elon — buying the say over what the machine says

comments.author: home
comments.text: Research note (2026-09-29): Fox News opinion framing is useful background, not a reader-story source. Its central mechanism reinforces this pitch: AI is becoming the layer between a person and the record—where a library or search result offered a field of sources, a chatbot supplies one synthesized answer. The relevant danger here is the branded feeling of independent thought: Grok can be sold as a way out of mediated consensus while its owner controls the system instructions, the information environment, and increasingly the work tool through which users receive that answer. Keep the story's present-tense scene on the person who hits Auto and never sees a masthead; do not turn the piece into a U.S.–China policy argument. Supporting studies linked from the column: ACL 2025 found partisan-biased LLMs affected political decision-making, including among users whose affiliation opposed the model's bias; Nature Communications (4,829 participants) found LLM-generated persuasive messages shifted policy attitudes.
